package/property/\"Description\".Target: Supplies local weather to sprinkler apps such as Smart Sprinkler so they can plan watering around rain, temperature, humidity, and wind. Local Weather uses the Hub's location to retrieve current conditions, seven days of recent hourly weather, and a seven-day forecast from Open-Meteo. The service refreshes weather automatically and keeps the last valid weather through restarts and temporary internet interruptions. Fresh weather requires location access and an internet connection. Each Hub can run one Local Weather service for multiple sprinkler apps.

package/resource/\"SPRINKLER_WEATHER_HIS.Target: Saved sprinkler weather update time for {0}.

package/resource/\"SPRINKLER_WEATHER_LOC.Target: Saved location used for sprinkler weather at {0}.

package/resource/\"api.open-meteo.com\".Target: Connect to Open-Meteo to retrieve current conditions, recent history, and forecasts for sprinkler planning.

package/resource/\"libertas.permission.A.Target: Use the Hub's location to request the correct local weather forecast.
